hypothesis: Daily Donchian breakouts on liquid alts, taken only while BTC is above its 100-day SMA, have positive net expectancy after costs with a 30-50% win rate (few large winners).
rulesChosenFrom: Standard trend-following literature (Donchian 20/10, 100d regime). Fixed before any daily data was fetched; no parameter search.
survivorshipNote: Includes pairs that were later delisted or renamed (e.g. MATICUSDT); their history simply ends.
execution: Signal on the daily close (00:00 UTC); fill at the next day's open. One position per symbol, equal size. Long only.
noRetuning: If the test fails, the result is recorded as a null. Any new variant gets a new version and a new unseen period (live paper from freeze date).
